crossRefs.note: Dinah, the daughter of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
They killed Hamor and Shechem, his son, with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went…
These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the souls of his sons…

translations.web: Afterwards, she bore a daughter, and named her Dinah.
translations.bsb: After that, Leah gave birth to a daughter and named her Dinah.
translations.kjv: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.
translations.asv: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.
